purpose: Technical, methodological, and research-craft question bank for the opening, pushback, and leadership turns of the Anduril Air Defense interview arc. Every pillar maps a posted Air Defense responsibility or qualification onto canonical resume evidence.
usage_policy: Anchor live technical turns to one pillar at a time. Never read a follow_up verbatim when the candidate's own words offer a sharper version of the same probe. Never repeat a pillar already covered earlier in the transcript. Answers to this bank are judged on technical reasoning structure — claim, method or mechanism, evidence and its limits, the threshold or decision it drives, and what would change it — not on STAR/STARE, which is reserved for behavioral and experience answers.

questions.question: State your Human Factors thesis for autonomous Air Defense in one sentence, and tell me what evidence would falsify it.
resume_and_role_links: Calibrated Cognitive Friction thesis
Principles for Agentic Trust — Alignment, Execution, Control, Calibration
ACM CSCW 2026 Industry Perspectives
JD: shape Air Defense product and program strategy using rigorous data and user insights

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: Give me your one-sentence thesis for Human Factors in autonomous Air Defense, and the single result that would force you to abandon it.
persona_adaptations.Systems / ML Engineering Lead: Calibrated Cognitive Friction is a philosophy. What measurable claim inside it can I actually test on a counter-drone C2 build?
persona_adaptations.Product Manager: In one sentence, what is your Human Factors bet for Air Defense, and what would it cost us if you are wrong?
persona_adaptations.Design Lead: What is your thesis about operator authority in autonomous C2, and where would it visibly change an interaction, not just a research memo?

follow_ups: Which of your four Agentic Trust dimensions fails first in a non-deterministic C2 system, and how would you detect that failure?
Name the specific study result that would falsify Calibrated Cognitive Friction rather than merely complicate it.
Where would adding friction make an Air Defense operator less safe, and how would you know you crossed that line?
questions.lead_staff_bar: Senior states a defensible thesis. Lead/Staff states the falsifier, the measurement that would detect it, and the organizational decision the thesis governs.

questions.question: You replaced arbitrary engineering latency targets with human perceptual thresholds. Walk me from the psychophysics to the written specification.
resume_and_role_links: Amazon $50M psychophysics latency program
US Patent US-12532040-B1 context-aware multimodal interaction architectures
Sling usability criteria for system latency, auditory and visual feedback, spatial layouts
JD: translate insights into decisions for autonomous counter-drone systems

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: Take me through the psychophysical method behind your latency thresholds: stimuli, staircase or method of limits, sample, and how you defended the threshold estimate.
persona_adaptations.Systems / ML Engineering Lead: Your threshold came from a population distribution. How do you turn that distribution into a single acceptance criterion I can verify in a test harness?
persona_adaptations.Product Manager: How did the perceptual threshold work actually change what engineering shipped, and what was the dollar consequence of the old arbitrary target?
persona_adaptations.Design Lead: Where does a perceptual latency threshold change the interaction itself — feedback timing, modality choice, or the moment we show uncertainty?

follow_ups: Which percentile of the operator population did you specify to, and who did that choice exclude?
What measurement method produced that number, and what was its confidence interval?
If the hardware cannot hit your threshold, what is the fallback specification and what degrades?
questions.lead_staff_bar: Senior reports a threshold. Lead/Staff shows the population-to-specification translation, the tail-risk decision, and the reusable method other teams inherited.

questions.question: When is fNIRS, eye tracking, or ECG worth the cost over NASA-TLX and behavioral performance data for an Air Defense operator study?
resume_and_role_links: Amazon fNIRS and eye-tracking objective cognitive load framework
Brigham and Women's / Harvard fMRI, ECG, and telemetry processing
Dissertation on working memory and reaction time under high-stress interruptions
JD: rigorous data and user insights under operational conditions

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: Defend your measure selection: what decision would fNIRS or eye tracking support for Air Defense that NASA-TLX and task performance would not?
persona_adaptations.Systems / ML Engineering Lead: Which of those signals could be instrumented in a fielded system, and which only survive in a lab? What do we lose in the field version?
persona_adaptations.Product Manager: Why should I fund biometric telemetry instead of another round of operator workflow testing this quarter?
persona_adaptations.Design Lead: What did eye tracking tell you about attention allocation that changed a layout, and how would that transfer to a dense 3D C2 display?

follow_ups: Take fNIRS away. What is your next-best measure, and what claim can you no longer make?
What is your evidence that the biometric signal tracked the operational failure you cared about, not just arousal?
How do you handle motion, noise, and gloves degrading those signals during in-field testing?
questions.lead_staff_bar: Senior selects a valid instrument. Lead/Staff states the decision the measure serves, the cheaper substitute, and when the measure becomes expensive theater.

questions.question: Walk me through a uFMEA for an autonomous threat recommendation that arrives with uncertain confidence, and where MIL-STD-1472 stops being enough.
resume_and_role_links: NASA Lunar Gateway clinical workstation uFMEA
NASA-STD-3001 and MIL-STD-1472 application
30% task-time reduction and eliminated critical input errors
JD preferred: support development of military standard systems

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: How would you structure a use-error analysis for counter-drone authorization so it produces research priorities, not just a risk register?
persona_adaptations.Systems / ML Engineering Lead: Give me severity, occurrence, and detectability for one high-consequence use error in an autonomous engagement flow, plus the control that closes it.
persona_adaptations.Product Manager: How do you keep a uFMEA from becoming a compliance ritual that slows every release by two weeks?
persona_adaptations.Design Lead: Which use-error modes are best mitigated by physical layout and control placement rather than by another confirmation dialog?

follow_ups: MIL-STD-1472 gives guidance, not product truth. Where would you deviate, and what evidence justifies the deviation?
Your NASA work cut task time 30%. Was speed the safety metric, or did something else actually eliminate the critical errors?
What is your stop-ship criterion, and who at Anduril would you expect to overrule it?
questions.lead_staff_bar: Senior applies the standard. Lead/Staff decides where the standard is wrong for this system and defines the evidence and escalation threshold that governs the deviation.

questions.question: What is the failure mode when the autonomy is correct but the operator's trust calibration is wrong, and how would you detect it before an incident?
resume_and_role_links: Principles for Agentic Trust — Calibration and Control
Mercedes-Benz L2/L3 handover trust and safety ratings
Meaningful Human Control
JD: AI-powered Lattice OS command and control over autonomous counter-drone systems

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: How do you measure trust calibration rather than trust, and what would over-trust look like in the telemetry before it looks like an incident?
persona_adaptations.Systems / ML Engineering Lead: The model changes after deployment. Which parts of your Human Factors validation must run again, and what signals must stay observable in production?
persona_adaptations.Product Manager: What would you measure after launch to decide whether to keep, remove, or increase a confirmation step?
persona_adaptations.Design Lead: How should the interface expose model uncertainty so an operator neither rubber-stamps nor second-guesses every recommendation?

follow_ups: Distinguish automation bias from complacency in your data. What separates them operationally?
What breaks when communications degrade, telemetry goes stale, or the operator is handling several simultaneous threats?
Your automotive handover evidence came from drivers, not warfighters. What transfers, and what absolutely does not?
questions.lead_staff_bar: Senior names automation bias. Lead/Staff defines the observable production signal, the revalidation trigger after model change, and the control that survives degraded operations.

questions.question: Map an operator's attention across detection, assessment, authorization, and intervention. Where does a dense 3D C2 interface compete with the mission?
resume_and_role_links: Uber urban field studies on information density under stress
Amazon multimodal interaction architecture and Echo Hub work

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: What research would you run first to model the operator's end-to-end workflow, and what artifact would outlive the study?

questions.question: Before touching screen design, what physical and anthropometric constraints would you investigate for a fielded Air Defense operator station?
resume_and_role_links: Sling reach-envelope modeling, anatomical safety, and mechanical fit specifications
Amazon hardware and multimodal device work
MIL-STD-1472 anthropometrics
JD preferred: hardware and Human Factors experience, ergonomics, military standard systems

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: How do you generate physical-ergonomic evidence fast enough to influence hardware before the industrial design freezes?
persona_adaptations.Systems / ML Engineering Lead: Turn a reach envelope or anthropometric finding into a hardware requirement with a pass/fail acceptance test.
persona_adaptations.Product Manager: Hardware changes are expensive and late changes are worse. How do you time ergonomic research so it is cheap to act on?
persona_adaptations.Design Lead: Where do physical constraints — gloves, vibration, sunlight, body armor, seated reach — override an otherwise clean interaction pattern?

follow_ups: Which anthropometric percentile range did you design to, and what happens to the operators outside it?
What use error did you catch through physical mock-up that no software prototype would have surfaced?
How do you validate mechanical fit and anatomical safety without a full production unit?
questions.lead_staff_bar: Senior runs an ergonomic evaluation. Lead/Staff writes the hard hardware specification and the acceptance test that hardware engineering must pass.

fMRI, ECG, and telemetry signal processing

persona_adaptations.Dr. Daniella Kim: With a small, hard-to-reach operator population, how do you keep a scaled survey or max-diff study statistically honest?
persona_adaptations.Systems / ML Engineering Lead: What sample size and effect size would you accept before I change a threshold in the system on your say-so?
